title: Anime T-Shirt
lyrics:
Walking down the street in my favorite anime tee
People looking sideways like what is that supposed to be
Graphic print faded from a thousand midnight streams
Living out my chapter inside fluorescent dreams

title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
lyrics:
Sakura in the springtime
Falling petals, fading light
You were eating every moment
Making memories before the night
You said you wanted my pancreas
To become a part of me
But I already gave you everything

title: Harem King
lyrics:
Harem King, harem king, he was so damn close
Rias on his arm, Akeno giving him the most
Season five was supposed to show us everything we bled for
Issei in white hair, the moment that we need more

title: Burn Through the Dark
lyrics:
I'll burn through the dark
I'll tear through the rain
No chain can hold me
No ghost can remain
I rise from the ash
I bleed but I stand

title: Sigma Crash Out V2
lyrics:
Woke up and chose violence hit the door frame first
Told myself I'm that guy then remembered my net worth
Ate a raw carrot called it clean eating day
Posted gym selfie from 2019 anyway

title: Sweater Weather
lyrics:
And all I am is a man
I want the world in my hands
I hate the beach, but I stand
In California, with my toes in the sand

title: Reflections
lyrics:
Where have you been?
Do you know when you're comin' back?
Since you've been gone
I've got along, but I've been sad

title: Softcore
album: Hard to Imagine The Neighbourhood Ever Changing
lyrics:
You've been my muse for a long time
You get me through every dark night
I'm always gone, out on the go

title: Daddy Issues
lyrics:
Go ahead and cry, little girl
Nobody does it like you do
I know how much it matters to you
I know that you got daddy issues
